_sources: genshin-impact.fandom.com /Promotional Code via api.php — dated, splits active from expired
_note: Codes perish. This is a timestamped snapshot, not a live feed. Re-check before trusting it. Account state on 2026-11-01: every code in THAT snapshot was already redeemed. Codes added on 2026-11-11 were not in that snapshot, so they are the ones worth trying — the six marked added 2026-08 / 2026-09 predate the baseline and were simply missed by the tracker, so their redemption status on this account is genuinely unknown. A dead or already-used code just errors, so there is no cost to trying any of them.
_next: 7.3 Special Program, roughly early December 2026 — three codes, ~300 Primogems, alive for about 24 hours
_howto: In game: Paimon Menu → Settings → Account → Redeem Code. Or the HoYoverse web redemption page. Needs AR 10; you are 45.
